verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a product-catalog search API (with an SDK and CLI) that exposes its own MCP server for other agents to connect to. Acting as an MCP client host that loads third-party MCP servers is a different product role for a data API of this kind. Its documented 'agentic mode' is an internal LLM search planner, not a facility for plugging in external tool servers, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships MCP-client capability.
